landmarks.name: The Nine Watchers
landmarks.note: Nine stones with lantern niches cut in their east faces and a fire before the middle one that is never let out. Hermit Bode keeps it.

landmarks.name: The Scarred Grove
landmarks.note: The deep grove, burnt to the heart in a ring, with one sapling in the char. The grove reader says the scar is older than the fire.

landmarks.name: Root's Tally
